user.title: IVAGO address
user.description: Enter your street and house number (as on ivago.be). Only addresses in the IVAGO area (Ghent and Destelbergen) are supported.

data_description.street_query: The beginning of the street name is enough, e.g. 'Kortrijkse'.
data_description.number: House number, optionally with box (e.g. 12 or 12A).

select_street.title: Select your street
select_street.description: Multiple streets found for house number {number}. Pick the right one.

reconfigure.title: Change IVAGO address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address. Entities are kept, the session is re-established.

data_description.street_query: The beginning of the street name is enough, e.g. 'Kortrijkse'.
data_description.number: House number, optionally with box (e.g. 12 or 12A).

error.street_not_found: Street not found. Use a street inside the IVAGO area.
error.invalid_address: IVAGO does not accept this address.
error.no_data: IVAGO returns no pickups for this address. Check the house number.

init.title: IVAGO options
init.description: How often the calendar is fetched and how far ahead.

data_description.scan_interval_hours: Default 12 hours. The calendar rarely changes; more than a few times a day is pointless.
data_description.lookahead_days: Default 90 days. Determines how far the calendar entity and 'upcoming' look ahead.
data_description.upcoming_days: Default 3. Drives the 'Upcoming pickup' sensor: today up to and including today + N days.
